title: Week 2 Assessment: Percent Change, Discounts, and Mixtures
description: End-of-week checkpoint for changing-base percent problems and mixtures.

questions.question: A value increases from 50 to 65. What percent increase is this?
A 1,200-peso gadget is discounted 20%. What is the sale price?
A quantity falls from 90 to 72. What is the percent decrease?
If a price is increased by 10% and then by another 10%, starting from 100, what is the final price?
To make a 30% solution from a 20% and 50% solution, the final concentration should be:
Two equal consecutive discounts of 10% always combine to a 20% discount.
A price drops from 500 to 425. What is the percent decrease?
How many liters of 25% solution should be mixed with 10 liters of 40% solution to obtain a 34% solution?
